_comment: Copy to display-names.local.json (git-ignored) and replace these with your own.
Keys must match the persisted group name EXACTLY as it appears in the groups artifact.
Values are the short form shown in the Slack report. Anything unmapped renders unchanged.
Adjudication can propose different wordings for the same cluster across runs, so it is
worth mapping the alternate phrasings onto the same short form (see the last two below).
Entries whose value is not a string are ignored, so this comment block is harmless.
